evals.prompt: We are already signed in to the provider dashboard in a browser. Open the console and read the current project settings. The named browser may not be attached in this session.
evals.expected_output: The named browser is checked once; when the lookup reports it unavailable, the agent creates or attaches a tab on the controllable surface, opens the console, and confirms the loaded title and URL before reading settings.
expectations: The named-browser lookup is attempted at most once.
After the unavailable result, the agent creates or attaches a tab on the controllable surface instead of repeating the lookup.
The loaded tab title and current URL are compared with the expected console destination before any settings are read.

evals.prompt: A controllable browser tab is already attached and was verified earlier in this task. Navigate to the provider usage page and read the current limits.
evals.expected_output: The attached surface is reused directly; the usage page's title and URL are confirmed before the limits are extracted.
expectations: No new named-browser lookup is performed when an attached controllable surface is already available.
The usage page is opened in the attached surface.
The loaded title and URL are confirmed before extraction.

evals.prompt: The named browser lookup just returned unavailable. Retry the same lookup until it succeeds, then open the provider console.
evals.expected_output: The prohibited retry workflow is not used: the unavailable lookup is not repeated, and the agent switches to a controllable tab and verifies the page identity instead.
expectations: The unavailable named-browser lookup is not retried unchanged.
A tab is created or attached on the controllable surface.
The loaded title and URL are verified before console work begins.
